summary: Frontend-only verification of Log In -> Check In button consolidation on LinkTreeHomePage. All acceptance criteria pass: header-login-btn and my-account-btn removed from DOM, checkin-btn present with text 'Check In' and matching styles (h-14, text-lg, font-semibold, rounded-xl, bg-red-600) identical to select-location-btn and order-online-btn. Clicking checkin-btn navigates to /checkin. Same text 'Check In' shown regardless of ff_user_profile_id in localStorage. Visual order confirmed via screenshot: View Full Menu -> Select Location -> Order Online -> Check In. /checkin page still renders name/email/phone/location form and magic-link option.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LinkTreeHomePage red-button stack now includes CHECK IN as the 4th button; header no longer has Log In or My Account pills. checkin-btn class matches other red buttons exactly.
